_doc: T4 recorded exceptions. Each entry declares ONE (spec, level, field) difference between the recorded golden and the current code, with the value it moves from, the value it moves to, the commit/bug id making the change, and why the new value is correct. While an entry is live the equivalence harness reports that difference as a RECORDED EXCEPTION instead of a failure, so the rest of the matrix keeps gating. Entries expire the moment 'old' stops matching (i.e. once the goldens are recaptured) and tests/test_equiv_golden.py::test_bug_ledger_entries_are_live then demands they be pruned. Schema and matching rules: equiv/ledger.py. Empty is the correct steady state. THIS FILE IS CURRENTLY NON-EMPTY BY DESIGN: see docs/rewrite/restructure/REBASELINE.md.

entries.justification: CONTROL_TRANSFER_SUBSET (reviewed at the L4 wave, tests/test_build.py DIVERGENCES). build() emits a strict SUBSET of the legacy 1-BYTE CONTROL send/recv pairs; every PAYLOAD transfer, collective, compute op and compute-microsecond total is identical. Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.
entries.dlsim_evidence: equiv.dlsim: bundle completes; group-order postcondition holds

Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.
entries.dlsim_evidence: equiv.dlsim: bundle completes; group-order postcondition holds

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.

Two causes, both contract decisions: (1) one logical p2p is ONE object with one tag, where legacy_lowering created one TransferOp per same-stage source parent; (2) R3 is per DEVICE (INTERFACES 4.3), so a cross-microbatch GPipe boundary is a device-local dep instead of legacy's 1-byte message fanned across the cluster ranks of a stage. Derived fields (dag_hash/ops_hash/bundle_hash/n_nodes/critical_path*/manifest*) move with those op counts. Evidence: every bundle completes under equiv.dlsim and the always-on group-order postcondition, and AstraSim runs all 42 specs to completion.
entries.dlsim_evidence: equiv.dlsim: bundle completes; group-order postcondition holds

entries.justification: BUG_LEDGER A3, fixed by construction. The tp-overlap head split used to drop is_moe_layer (OVERLAP_NODE_COPY_ATTRS omitted it), so the memory census filed the head of a split MoE layer as a SECOND dense layer and double-counted it. build() derives every field of a split op from the same WorkItem, so the flag cannot be lost (INTERFACES 7: 'already impossible'). The predicted direction and shape hold: the reported peak DECREASES by one dense layer's worth per split MoE layer per device. Timing is unaffected.
entries.dlsim_evidence: equiv.dlsim: bundle completes; group-order postcondition holds

entries.justification: Wire group-id NUMBERING only. The four groups involved are SINGLETONS (the ep-axis communicator of a COARSE program, whose device space carries no ep axis - ABSENT_AXIS_SINGLETON_GROUP), and a singleton wire group is emitted as a zero-duration *_noop COMP, never as a collective (Class B 10g). The SET of member sets is unchanged ({[0],[1],[2],[3]}); only which gid each is interned under moved, because gids are allocated in sorted-LABEL order and the labels are assigned in program order. equiv.canonical's collectives_by_group - the T1 quantity keyed on the member set rather than the gid - is identical.
entries.dlsim_evidence: equiv.dlsim: bundle completes; group-order postcondition holds
